messages:
Nina (devex): FYI ran into several parity gaps between python SDK 0.9.7 and REST for bulk embeddings + async handling. Blocking sample-app onboarding. Short repro included below. Anyone on embedders awake?

Luis: what gaps? missing params or different status codes?

Nina (devex): Both. REST accepts `batch_hint` (helps routing) and returns 202 + { queue_id } for big jobs with an `on_complete` webhook option. Py SDK silently strips `batch_hint` and immediately raises on 429 (no enqueue path). Sample app expects webhook callback and hangs.

Tom: ugh. Which client call did you use? python or generated client?

Nina (devex): python package `redwood_inference==0.9.7` using client.embeddings.create(...). Repro: `curl` works and shows 202 + queue id; SDK call returns HTTPError(429) and no queue id.

Nina (devex): curl (works):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
 -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","inputs":["x","y"],"batch_hint":"large-batch","on_complete":{"url":"https://hook.site/...","format":"json"}}'
```
-> 202 {"queue_id":"q_12345"} + later webhook POST to on_complete URL.

Nina (devex): python SDK (broken):
```py
from redwood import Redwood
c = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('TOKEN'))
c.embeddings.create(model='rwd-embed-1', inputs=['x','y'], batch_hint='large-batch', on_complete={'url':'https://hook.site/..'})
# -> raises redwood.errors.HTTPError: 429 Too Many Requests
```

Luis: can you capture the outgoing JSON from the SDK? maybe keys are nested. Also which transport lib (requests/urllib3/aiohttp)?

Nina (devex): SDK sent body: `{"model":"rwd-embed-1","inputs":["x","y"],"options":{}}` -> `batch_hint` and `on_complete` moved into `options` but server expects top-level `batch_hint` and `on_complete`. Also SDK sets `Retry-After` handling to not retry on 429 for embeddings. REST will accept and queue.

Tom: sounds like a serializer mismatch + retry policy. I think we had legacy `options` wrapper for older endpoints; recent API flattened fields and SDK generator probably didn't update the override.

Jade: This is high priority for onboarding. I'll open an issue and tag eng-ml/runtime + sdk team; we should support webhook/on_complete parity and align retry semantics. Can you add a failing unit test that asserts payload shape?

ci-bot: Created issue #2010: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/2010 on behalf of Nina — "py SDK: embeddings payload flattening + 429 enqueue mismatch" :bug:

Luis: For Dedicated customers we must preserve current behavior behind a feature flag. If we change default enqueue semantics it could break some flows. Add a compatibility flag in config.

Tom: I'll take serializer fix (branch: fix/flatten-embeds-payload). Will add a regression test that posts to a small httptest server to assert top-level `on_complete`/`batch_hint`.

Jade: I'll add a sample-app e2e job that mocks the webhook and validates app proceeds after queue callback. Also add a canary in staging so we don't block new signups.

Nina (devex): Thanks. After serializer + retry fixes and a patched release (0.9.8) we should run onboarding flow and confirm webhook delivery + no-hang. Will follow up with PR links and staging canary results.

Luis: FYI I'll coordinate with infra to ensure the runtime accepts both `options` wrapper for a short deprecation window if we need time to rollout safely.

Nina (devex): Great. Tagging @Tom and @Jade. Will update this thread when PRs land.
